key_insight: The paper reframes hyperparameter tuning as an interpretable game, using Shapley Effects to reveal which hyperparameters most influence each objective.
engineering_relevance: It helps engineers narrow the search space, prioritize the most impactful knobs, and evaluate models early in multi-objective settings.
method: Compute global hyperparameter sensitivity with Shapley Effects.
Identify effective configurations using Pareto front sets.
Compare hyperparameter-objective interactions across multiple neural architectures and domains.
evidence_signal: The framework is demonstrated on three distinct neural network architectures across different problem domains under multi-objective evaluation.
watch_item: Shapley-based analysis can be computationally expensive and may depend on how objectives, search spaces, and model runs are defined.
paper_title: Which Hyperparameters Matter? A Game-Theoretic Framework for Interpretable Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis
